title: Wish they were longer
text: Wish they were longer. These straws are fine but not as long as I was expecting. I buy the same brand and color scheme from Bed Bath and Beyond and they are maybe 1/2 in longer, which allows me to use with my Tervis cups. These straws are too short for use with large Tervis tumblers

product_metadata.title: Kizmos Flex Straws, Assorted, 500 Count
features: Included in each package are 500 straws of various colors
Each straw is made of disposable and recyclable plastic
Sip milk, soda, juice, and more with these straws
Straws measure 8-1/4 inch long, and flexed measure 8-1/2 inch long
Colors included, blue, green, yellow, orange, purple, and red
description: Add the finishing touches to your bar area with this set of Kizmo's Jumbo Flex Straws. The flexible "top" makes getting drinks much easier. Set contains 125 assorted colored straws. Straws measure 8-1/4 inch long, and flexed measure 8-1/2 inch long x 1/4 inch diameter.
